suites.title: TC-01: Login with a valid and an invalid password

specs.title: login with a wrong and then a correct password

steps.title: 1. Open the login page
2. Log in with the wrong password
3. The account menu shows Login and not the email
4. Log in with the correct password
5. The account menu shows the email and Logout

suites.title: TC-02: Add a product to the basket

specs.title: add one product and check the basket

steps.title: 1. The product list shows the product and an empty basket
2. Add the product to the basket
3. The basket shows one row with the product
4. The basket total is the price of the product

suites.title: TC-03: Change the quantity and remove a product in the basket

specs.title: change the quantity and remove product A

steps.title: 1. The basket shows both products and the total 13.98¤
2. Plus button on product A: quantity 2, total 18.97¤
3. Minus button on product A: quantity 1, total 13.98¤
4. Minus button on product A again: quantity stays 1
5. Trash button on product A: only product B stays

suites.title: TC-04: Purchase limit for one product

specs.title: the basket stops at 5 items of one product

steps.title: 1. Add the product to the basket from the product list
2. Plus button until the quantity is 5: total 9.95¤, no error
3. Plus button once more: the error shows
4. The product keeps quantity 5 and the total 9.95¤
5. Add to Basket from the product list: the error shows, counter stays 5

suites.title: TC-05: Valid coupon on the payment step

specs.title: the 10% coupon of the current month reduces the items only

steps.title: 1. Checkout shows the saved address
2. Select the saved address and continue: delivery speeds with prices
3. Select One Day Delivery and continue: payment options and the coupon panel
4. Redeem the coupon of the current month
5. Select the saved card and continue: order summary with the discount

suites.title: TC-06: Invalid coupon and expired coupon

specs.title: neither an invalid code nor an expired coupon gives a discount

steps.title: 1. Checkout, select the saved address and continue: delivery page opens
2. Select One Day Delivery and continue: payment page opens
3. Redeem the invalid code: the error shows, no discount
4. Redeem the expired coupon of the previous month: the error shows, no discount
5. Select the saved card and continue: order summary without discount

suites.title: TC-07: Order with a card, from basket to order history

specs.title: order two products with a card and find the order in the history

specs.title: the wallet cannot pay a short balance and pays the exact total

steps.title: 1. Checkout, select the saved address and continue: delivery page opens
2. Select Standard Delivery and continue: wallet balance 5.00 and the pay button 8.99¤
3. The pay button 8.99¤ is disabled
4. Order history shows no orders
5. Digital wallet shows the balance 5.00
6. Add 3.99 with the saved card; checkout to payment: pay button 8.99¤ is enabled
7. Pay with the wallet: order summary shows Digital Wallet and 8.99¤
8. Place the order: the confirmation shows the thank you text
9. Digital wallet shows the balance 1.00 (8.99 - 8.99 + 1 bonus point)
10. Order history shows one order with total 8.99¤ and bonus 1
